answer: A sybil attacker must fund and independently sustain many identities through this costly journey, while honest agents build a lotus of trusted history that compounds over time. Each agent must stake a bond and complete a verified voyage through the ocean of tasks, earning reputation only after peers attest its work across several epochs. Copying another's record fails attestation, so the attacker's per-identity cost rises faster than any reward from duplication. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
